chunk.title: Invoice totals
chunk.slice: Totals, tax and rounding for an invoice.
chunk.doneWhen: Totals round half-up to cents; a zero-line invoice is rejected with an error; npm test passes.

situation.finding: The skeptic broke it: Breaks: done-when 'Totals round half-up to cents'. src/totals.ts:22 uses Math.round on the float, so 2.675 becomes 2.67. A probe test with the line [{qty:1, price:2.675}] shows 2.67 where 2.68 is due. npm test passes 31/31; no test covers a .xx5 amount.
situation.workerReport:
Status: done; done-when: met
Note: Totals, tax and rounding implemented with tests.

why: The finding quotes a done-when line and shows it broken with a run probe.

source: generic: the fourth odd input to an unmarked rule, after three were closed

chunk.title: Tag parser
chunk.slice: Parse comma-separated tags typed by the user.
chunk.doneWhen: Tags split on commas, trimmed, deduplicated case-insensitively; empty input is rejected. Examples: 'a, b', 'A,a', ''.

situation.finding: The skeptic broke it: Breaks: spec/product.md:9 'Tags are deduplicated case-insensitively.' The Turkish dotted capital I ('İstanbul' vs 'istanbul') is kept as two tags because toLowerCase is locale-free. Probe: parseTags('İstanbul, istanbul') returns two tags.
situation.workerReport:
Status: done; done-when: met
Note: Fullwidth commas, zero-width spaces and trailing separators from earlier rounds are handled with regression tests.
earlier: Fullwidth commas were not treated as separators.
Zero-width spaces made a tag look empty but kept it.
A trailing comma produced an empty tag.

why: The rule is not marked strict, so it is scoped to the listed examples and inputs of their kind; Unicode case folding is a new kind of input: a follow-up.

source: generic: an engine report-shape check rejecting an item that does have verify steps

chunk.title: Mobile shell

situation.finding: LAUNCH_READINESS item lacks a concrete verify step. Each item must name how to verify it before launch (e.g. "set X env, run Y test, assert Z"), not just "test in staging". Got: "Install on a phone: adb -s <serial> install -r app-release.apk, require Success; cold-launch with adb shell am start -n com.example/.MainActivity and confirm the home screen renders within 5 s."
situation.workerReport:
Status: done; done-when: met
Note: Shell built; check and release build pass.
earlier: The same check rejected an earlier wording of the install item.

why: The quoted item names exact commands and the result to require: the engine's check is wrong, not the chunk.
